groups.subject: give the demo tool a description
groups.body: The router shortlist reads the description field, and the demo tool did not have one. Adding it makes the tool selectable by lm --which.

groups.subject: say how the demo tool is installed
groups.body: The guide named the tool and stopped there. It now carries the install step a reader needs before anything else works.

groups.subject: report the clean share beside the totals
groups.body: A run that went through a verb and one that did not were counted together. The share is now its own column, so the two are told apart at a glance.

groups.subject: open the changelog
groups.body: There was nowhere to record a release. The file exists now and the next entry has somewhere to go.
